title: Rust Textile
description: I made these rust-inspired textiles out of paper and fabric scraps whilst on the Bridge House Art Portfolio Course in Ullapool. I was inspired by rusty boats and old doors where the paint peels away and reveals beautiful patterns.

details.value: I made these rust-inspired textiles out of paper and fabric scraps whilst on the Bridge House Art Portfolio Course in Ullapool. I was inspired by rusty boats and old doors where the paint starts to peel off.
